1.w: Blessed [are] those complete in the way, those walking in the law of YHWH.

2.w: Blessed [are] those keeping His testimonies; with all the heart they seek Him.

3.w: Also they do not do injustice; in His ways they walk.

4.w: You have commanded Your precepts, to be kept diligently.

5.w: Oh, that my ways were set firm to keep Your statutes!

6.w: Then I would not be ashamed, in my looking to all Your commandments.

7.w: I will praise You with uprightness of heart, in my learning the judgments of Your righteousness.

8.w: Your statutes I will keep; may You not even to exceedingly forsake me!

9.w: How can a young man keep pure his way? By guarding [it] according to Your word.

10.w: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.

11.w: In my heart I have hidden Your word, that I should not sin against You.

12.w: Blessed [are] You, O YHWH; teach me Your statutes.

13.w: With my lips I have recounted all the judgments of Your mouth.

14.w: In the way of Your testimonies I rejoice, more than in all wealth.

15.w: May I meditate on Your precepts and look upon Your paths.

16.w: In Your statutes I will delight myself; I will not forget Your word.

17.w: Deal bountifully with Your servant, [that] I may live and keep Your word.

18.w: Open my eyes, that I may see the wonders from Your law.

19.w: I [am] a sojourner on the earth; do not hide from me Your commandments!

20.w: My soul is crushed with longing for Your judgments at all times.

21.w: You rebuke the arrogant ones, the accursed ones, those going astray from Your commandments.

22.w: Remove from me scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.

23.w: Though princes sit against me and slander, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.

24.w: Your testimonies also [are] my delight—the men of my counsel.

25.w: My soul clings to the dust; revive me according to Your word!

26.w: My ways I recounted, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.

27.w: Make me understand the way of Your precepts, that I may meditate on Your wonders.

28.w: My soul drips from sorrow; establish me according to Your word!

29.w: Turn away from me the path of deceit, and [with] Your law show favor to me.

30.w: The way of truth I have chosen; Your ordinances I have set.

31.w: I cling to Your testimonies, O YHWH; let me not be put to shame!

32.w: The way of Your commandments I will run, for You will enlarge my heart.

33.w: Teach me, O YHWH, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep it [to] the end.

34.w: Give me understanding, and I will guard Your law, and I will keep it with all [my] heart.

35.w: Cause me to tread in the path of Your commandments, for in it I delight.

36.w: Incline my heart toward Your testimonies, and not toward dishonest gain.

37.w: Make my eyes pass from seeing the vain [thing]; with Your word revive me.

38.w: Make Your word stand for Your servant, which [is] for the fearing of You.

39.w: Remove the reproach that I dread, for Your judgments [are] good.

40.w: Behold, I long for Your precepts; Revive me in Your righteousness!

41.w: And may Your loving devotion come to me, O YHWH, Your salvation according to Your word.

42.w: Then I will answer with a word for the one reproaching me, for I trust in Your word.

43.w: And do not take away from my mouth the word of truth even to exceedingly! For in Your judgments I have hoped.

44.w: And I will keep Your law continually, forever and ever,

45.w: and I will walk in a broad place, for Your precepts I have sought.

46.w: And I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.

47.w: And I will delight myself in Your commandments, which I have loved.

48.w: And I will lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I have loved, and I will meditate on Your statutes.

49.w: Remember the word to Your servant, upon that You have caused me to hope.

50.w: This [is] my comfort in my affliction, for Your word has given me life.

51.w: The arrogant ones mock me even to exceedingly; from Your law I do not stretch away.

52.w: I remember Your judgments from old, O YHWH, and I am comforted.

53.w: Indignation has seized me, from the wicked forsaking Your law.

54.w: Your statutes have been songs to me, in the house of my sojourning.

55.w: I remember Your name in the night, O YHWH, and I keep Your law.

56.w: This has come to be for me, for I have kept Your precepts.

57.w: YHWH [is] my portion; I have said I would keep Your words.

58.w: I appeased Your face with all [my] heart; be gracious to me according to Your word.

59.w: I have considered my paths, and turned back my feet to Your testimonies.

60.w: I hurried and did not delay to keep Your commandments.

61.w: The cords of the wicked have surrounded me, Your law I have not forgotten.

62.w: [In] the middle of the night, I rise to give thanks to You, upon the judgments of Your righteousness.

63.w: I [am] a companion to all who fear You, and to those keeping Your precepts.

64.w: O YHWH, with Your loving devotion the earth is full; teach me Your statutes.

65.w: You have done well with Your servant, O YHWH, according to Your word.

66.w: So may You teach me good judgment and knowledge, for in Your commandments I have believed.

67.w: Before I was afflicted, I was going astray; and now I have kept Your word.

68.w: You [are] good, and the One doing good; may You teach me Your statutes.

69.w: The arrogant ones have smeared a lie over me; I, with all [my] heart, will guard Your precepts.

70.w: Their heart is unfeeling like fat; I have delighted in Your law.

71.w: [It is] good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn Your statutes.

72.w: The law from Your mouth [is] better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

73.w: Your hands have made me and established me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.

74.w: Those fearing You see me and rejoice, because in Your word I have hoped.

75.w: I know, O YHWH, that Your judgments [are] righteous, and in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

76.w: Your loving devotion, may it be, please, to comfort me, according to Your word to Your servant.

77.w: May Your compassions come to me, that I may live, for Your law [is] my delight.

78.w: May the arrogant ones be put to shame, for with a lie they dealt perversely with me; I will meditate on Your precepts.

79.w: Let those who fear You turn to me, and those who know Your testimonies.

80.w: May my heart be perfect in Your statutes, so that I may not be ashamed.

81.w: My soul faints for Your salvation; for Your word I wait.

82.w: My eyes fail for your word, saying, “When will You comfort me?”

83.w: For, I have become like a wineskin in smoke; Your statutes I have not forgotten.

84.w: How many [are] the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment on my pursuers?

85.w: The arrogant ones have dug pits for me that [are] not according to Your law.

86.w: All Your commandments [are] firm, falsely they pursue me—Help me!

87.w: Almost they consumed me on the earth; and I have not forsaken Your precepts.

88.w: According to Your loving devotion, revive me, that I may keep the testimony of Your mouth.

89.w: Forever, O YHWH, [is] Your word, standing fixed in the heavens.

90.w: For generation and generation [is] Your faithfulness; You established the earth, and it stands.

91.w: According to Your ordinances, they stand this day, for all things [are] Your servants.

92.w: Had Your law not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.

93.w: Forever, I will not forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.

94.w: Unto You I am—save me! For I have sought Your precepts.

95.w: The wicked wait for me to destroy me; Your testimonies I will consider.

96.w: To all perfection I have seen an end; broad [is] Your commandment exceedingly.

97.w: Oh, how I love Your law! All the day, it [is] my meditation.

98.w: [By] Your commandment You make me wiser than my enemies; for, it [is] with me forever.

99.w: I have insight above all my teachers, for Your testimonies [are] a meditation to me.

100.w: I understand above elders, for Your precepts I have kept.

101.w: From every path of evil I have restrained my feet, that I may keep Your word.

102.w: From Your ordinances I have not turned aside, for You have instructed me.

103.w: How smooth are Your words to my palate, more than honey to my mouth!

104.w: From Your precepts I gain understanding; upon thus, I hate every path of deception!

105.w: Your word [is] a lamp to my feet, and a light to my path.

106.w: I have sworn and confirmed: I will keep the judgments of Your righteousness.

107.w: I am afflicted even exceedingly, O YHWH; revive me according to Your word!

108.w: May You accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, please, O YHWH, and may You teach me Your judgments.

109.w: My soul [is] in my hand continually, and I do not forget Your law.

110.w: The wicked have set a snare for me, and from Your precepts I do not go astray.

111.w: I have inherited Your testimonies forever; for they [are] the joy of my heart.

112.w: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes forever, [to] the end!

113.w: The double-minded I hate, and Your law I love.

114.w: You [are] my hiding place and my shield; in Your word I hope.

115.w: Turn away from me, O evildoers! And I will keep the commandments of my God.

116.w: Uphold me according to Your word, and l will live; and do not make me ashamed of my hope!

117.w: Support me, and I will be saved; and I will gaze on Your statutes continually.

118.w: You have trodden down all those going astray from Your statutes, for their treachery [is] falsehood.

119.w: Like dross You put an end to all the wicked of the earth; therefore I love Your testimonies.

120.w: My flesh bristles from dread of You, and of your judgments I have been afraid.

121.w: I have done justice and righteousness; do not leave me to my oppressors!

122.w: Ensure Your servant for good; do not let the arrogant ones oppress me.

123.w: My eyes fail for Your salvation, and for the word of Your righteousness.

124.w: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.

125.w: I [am] Your servant—give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.

126.w: [It is] time, O YHWH, to act; they have broken Your law!

127.w: Upon thus, I love Your commandments more than gold, and more than fine gold.

128.w: Upon thus, all the precepts I have declared wholly right; every path of deception I hate.

129.w: Wonderful [are] Your testimonies; upon thus, my soul has kept watch [over] them.

130.w: The opening of Your words gives light, giving understanding to the simple ones.

131.w: I have opened my mouth and I pant—for I have longed for Your commandments!

132.w: Turn to me and be gracious to me, according to justice to those loving Your name.

133.w: Establish my steps by Your word, and do not let any iniquity rule over me.

134.w: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.

135.w: Make Your face shine on Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.

136.w: Streams of waters run down from my eyes, because they have not kept Your law.

137.w: You [are] righteous, O YHWH, and Your judgments [are] upright.

138.w: You have appointed your righteous testimonies, and exceedingly faithful.

139.w: My zeal has cut me off, because my adversaries have forgotten Your words.

140.w: Your word [is] exceedingly pure, and Your servant has loved it.

141.w: I [am] little and despised; I do not forget Your precepts.

142.w: Your righteousness [is] righteous forever, and Your law [is] truth.

143.w: Trouble and distress have found me; Your commandments [are] my delight.

144.w: The righteousness of Your testimonies [is] forever; give me understanding, that I may live!

145.w: I cry out with all [my] heart; answer me, O YHWH! Your statutes I will guard.

146.w: I call out to You, save me, that I may keep Your testimonies!

147.w: I went ahead at the dawn, and I cried out, [and] for Your word I have hoped.

148.w: My eyes have gone before the watches to meditate on Your word.

149.w: Hear my voice, O YHWH, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your justice, preserve my life!

150.w: They draw near, those pursuing wickedness! From Your law they are far.

151.w: You [are] near, O YHWH, and all Your commandments [are] truth.

152.w: I have known of Your testimonies of old, that forever You have founded them.

153.w: See my affliction and rescue me! For I have not forgotten Your law.

154.w: Plead my plea and redeem me; according to Your word, revive me!

155.w: Far from the wicked [is] salvation, because they have not not sought Your statutes.

156.w: Your mercies [are] great, O YHWH; according to Your ordinances, revive me!

157.w: Many [are] my pursuers and my adversaries; from Your testimonies I have not turned aside.

158.w: I have seen those acting treacherously, and I felt loathing, because they have not kept Your word.

159.w: See, how I love Your precepts, O YHWH; according to Your loving devotion, revive me!

160.w: The head of Your word [is] truth, and every judgment of Your righteousness [is] forever.

161.w: Princes may pursue me without cause, and of Your word my heart was afraid.

162.w: I [am] rejoicing over Your word like one finding great plunder.

163.w: Deception I hate and abhor; Your law I do love.

164.w: Seven times in the day I praise You, because of the judgments of Your righteousness.

165.w: Great prosperity [is] unto those loving Your law, and nothing to them [is] a stumbling block.

166.w: I wait for Your salvation, O YHWH, and Your commandments I have done.

167.w: My soul has kept Your testimonies, and I love them exceedingly.

168.w: I have kept Your precepts and Your testimonies, because all my ways [are] before You.

169.w: Let my cry come before You, O YHWH; according to Your word, give me understanding.

170.w: Let my supplication come before You; according to Your word, deliver me.

171.w: Let my lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.

172.w: Let my tongue sing out Your word, for all Your commandments [are] righteous.

173.w: Let Your hand be to help me, for Your precepts I have chosen.

174.w: I long for Your salvation, O YHWH, and Your law [is] my delight.

175.w: Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; and may Your judgments help me.

176.w: I have gone astray, getting lost like a sheep; may You seek Your servant, for Your commandments I have not forgotten.
